tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, and log areas on ground. Text on them: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on panel (menus, tile hover state). Text on them: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Subtle dividers and card borders used only for grouping. Never use as the sole indicator of a state.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders, toggle track in the off state. At least 3:1 contrast against ground and panel.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Default text and icons on ground, panel, panel-raised, and accent-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, timestamps, and labels on ground, panel, panel-raised, and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Light yellow: fill for primary actions and the on state of toggles. Text on it: on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of the accent fill. Text on it: on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Accent-colored borders and lines (active tile, toggle border). At least 3:1 contrast against ground and panel in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent-colored text and values on ground, panel, and accent-soft. At least 4.5:1 contrast.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an active tile (light on, heater running). Text on it: ink, ink-muted, accent-text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid, 2px offset. At least 3:1 contrast against ground, panel, and panel-raised.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success (build passed, device reachable). Always pair with a word or icon; never use alone. Text on ground and panel.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and actual problems (build failed, device offline). Always pair with a word or icon. Text on ground and panel.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices and links. Text on ground and panel.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page title and cover. Use at most once per page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The hallway heater is set to 21.5 degrees.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small labels and chips. Set text in uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Spacing between the title and metadata line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text spacing, spacing between tiles.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside small elements, gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default spacing between elements.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Spacing between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Spacing between sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Desktop page margin.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Input fields, code blocks, small surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and device tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, toggle track, and toggle thumb.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Soft glow behind an active device tile. No other shadows.
